autoOpen.title: Auto-open
autoOpen.notWired: · geofencing not wired in this build
autoOpen.info: Opens the gate when you arrive, leave, or connect the car. While Auto-open is on, Android can show a “Searching for nearby gates” notice (same idea as PalGate). You can hide that notice in Settings → Notifications without stopping monitoring. After an open, the next check is at that gate’s cooldown — not a 2-minute GPS batch.

permissions.title: Permissions checklist
permissions.body: Grant these before enabling auto-open. Always location and unrestricted battery matter most on Samsung. Monitoring works after swipe-away and reboot when Unrestricted; Force stop in App info fully disables auto-open until you open GateAuto again (Android OS rule — no app can restart itself after Force stop).
permissions.locFgDetail: Needed to place pins and refine arrival before opening.
permissions.locBgDetail: Required for background geofence enter detection.
permissions.notifDetail: Open/fail alerts when a gate triggers. While Auto-open is on, Android pins a “Searching for nearby gates” notice that cannot be swiped away (required, same as PalGate).
permissions.btDetail: Nearby devices permission so car matching can read connected devices. Bluetooth being on is not the same.
permissions.samsungDetail: Galaxy S25 Ultra (One UI) can block geofence and Bluetooth wakes unless GateAuto is unrestricted. Swipe-away from Recents is OK; Force stop in App info fully kills auto-open until you open the app. Leave the pinned “Searching for nearby gates” notice up. Do all of these:
permissions.samsungSteps:
1. Apps → GateAuto → Battery → set to Unrestricted
2. Never put GateAuto to sleep (Sleeping apps / Deep sleeping apps → remove GateAuto)
3. Keep notifications allowed (pinned “Searching for nearby gates” + open success/fail alerts)
permissions.bgLocationDetail: Choose Always Allow for GateAuto so geofences can wake the app when you arrive at a gate.
permissions.setupBody: Always location, alerts, and Unrestricted battery so gates can open while locked.
permissions.banner: Auto-open needs Always location and Unrestricted battery

link.title: Link PalGate account
link.bodyPrimary: Scan with PalGate on this phone: keep this screen’s notification (“GateAuto linking…”), switch to PalGate, scan the QR, then return. GateAuto runs a short foreground keep-alive so the long-poll can continue (or auto-restarts within ~1s when you come back).
link.bodyAnother: Scan a Linked Device QR from a different PalGate account (another neighborhood or home). Keep this screen’s notification, switch to PalGate, scan, then return.
link.emulatorNote: Why emulator used to be required: fully switching apps often killed the waiting GET. This path is the no-emulator workaround. Emulator → Export → Import on this phone still works if you prefer it.
link.alreadyBody: This phone already has PalGate credentials. Add another system from Gate systems, or import a replacement payload below.
link.importFoot: Paste the export JSON from another GateAuto device. Do not share publicly.
link.importHelp: Scan the Export QR with any QR reader (or copy from the other device), then paste the JSON here. Payload is not written to the event log.
link.minimize: Long-poll in flight — you can minimize now and open PalGate to scan.
link.waitPoll: Wait until status says “Long-poll in flight”, then minimize and scan in PalGate.
link.longPressPaste: Long-press the field and choose Paste.
link.needFields: Need phone number, hex session token, and type 0/1/2.
link.footnote: If PalGate already shows a linked device for a previous scan, remove it there, tap New QR here, wait for “Long-poll in flight”, then scan. Allow location while linking — Android uses it only for the keep-alive notification (not for gate opens).

export.title: Export account
export.body: Scan this QR with the other phone’s GateAuto Import, or copy the JSON and paste it there. Personal transfer only — anyone with this payload can use your Linked Device session.
export.noClipboard: Long-press the JSON below to copy (clipboard module needs a rebuild).
